title: Vinaigrette - curry-ish based
preamble:
Ingredients:-
3
tablespoons fresh lime juice
1
tablespoon fresh orange juice
1
tablespoon Dijon mustard
1
teaspoon curry powder, toasted
1/2
teaspoon salt
1/4
teaspoon black pepper
1/2
cup olive oil

Method:-
Whisk together any meat juices (if cooking meat for the salad!! ), mustard, curry powder, salt, and pepper, then add oil in a stream, whisking until emulsified.
